basis_and_conventions.Q: SL2(Z/12)/global +/-1, with D25 generators and ordered BFS graph basis
basis_and_conventions.coefficient_orientation: Bit0 and cycle0 are the first basis entry; H graph edges point from the s vertex to the r vertex. Arithmetic fields enter only through the already proved D25 CM obstruction.

external_references: No additional external theorem is assumed. The finite-shadow definition and CM nonarithmeticality are used through D25, and the P3 action through D27. Group-cover, averaging, and maximal-common-quotient maps are proved in D28.
